set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

uid [parameter2].explanation: Configure the system to log in the user 's UID.

class [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication plaintext-password [param.explanation: Configure the password for the system to log in to the user.

authentication-order [parameter2].explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system login user.

set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.
